name: mirage
text: That settles what is being sent: ticker KXNFLRSHATT-26OCT25LARLV-LVAJEANTY2-14, NO, 1 contract at 42c, immediate-or-cancel, with Kalshi cash $6.29, and Kalshi answers insufficient_balance. Looking at the order form, the app sends a NO buy as a sell of YES at 58c, which Kalshi may charge as if you were selling something you don't own. I'm switching NO buys to the older order form that names the NO side directly (if Kalshi has retired it, the app falls back to the current form automatically, and a refusal places nothing, so there's no double order). Shipping as v1.0.56 with a test; I'll ask you to try one more bet then. If it still says insufficient, then the problem is on the Kalshi account side and I'll tell you what to check.
